core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khaleel corresponds to the Arabic form خليل (Arabic root خ ل ل (kh-l-l); خَلِيل (Khalīl)). Its core sense is friend, intimate companion. Khaleel is Arabic خَلِيل (Khalīl) 'friend, intimate companion', from the root خ ل ل (kh-l-l); it is an epithet of Abraham (خليل الله). The source gloss 'Friend of Allah' is broadly consistent. Same name as khalil.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Khaleel, khaleel. Script forms are خليل, خلیل, ख़लील.
